decisions.reason: As a very recent launch in the firm's core heat-exchanger and air-cooling field, it has already received public commitment and is likely to be given more time rather than withdrawn quickly.

Because the firm has already invested in development and market introduction of this condenser and it fits its established engineering domain, management is likely to continue backing it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

Even if overlap with other condenser offerings could raise questions, the recent launch and visible commitment make it more likely that management persists and attributes any weak early traction to temporary market factors.
This repair-oriented niche product may be somewhat less central than full cooling units, but the sunk development effort and public listing still make continued support more likely than a quick exit.

A customized industrial air cooler is highly consistent with the capabilities and customer logic of a mature German machinery producer, so management would be especially inclined to keep it on the market.
Although a specialized repair insert could be a narrower offering, escalation of commitment and the product's close fit with the firm's technical base favor retaining it for at least another year.
